guest.titre: Senior Director of Affiliate Relations and Education
guest.bio_context: Brian Henry has worked in the pump and plumbing industry since 1989, starting as a pump professional at a major U.S. pump manufacturer where he spent approximately 25 years in the marketing department before transitioning to his current role at ASPE. He has extensive experience with industry events including WEFTEC and has been involved with ASPE conferences for considerable time.

pending_qa.q: What is the schedule and structure of the American Society of Plumbing Engineers annual convention?
pending_qa.r: The ASPE convention includes a Women of ASPE event on Friday, followed by the business meeting on Saturday handling bylaws and board elections running through mid-afternoon Sunday. Sunday evening features a unique venue called Chicken and Pickle with outdoor activities including pickleball. Monday morning includes membership awards, with the expo starting just before lunchtime Monday and running through Tuesday afternoon, followed by education sessions and technical workshops for CEU credits.
